issue.title: Task requirements (reqs)
issue.description: A task can carry requirements: checkbox children without `#task`, nested as deep as the work needs, drawn as a quiet ⌗⌗ run in the task's ink. They are met when the task closes and can never be ticked early. They can be dropped with a reason or carried into their own task, and the close card audits them once. They sit in one canonical block order beside a NOTES drawer, and they promote one level at a time into project tasks. bob-cli, bob-plugins, Bob Mac Capture, and the vault agree byte for byte through shared vectors, and every legacy REQUIREMENTS drawer becomes NOTES.

DISCOVERED ISSUE (from bob-cli-on.6.1.4 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1, reproduced and widened by the bob-cli-on.6.1 land agent on master 3ce97d73): NOTES routing for a req-owning ^prj task writes into an H2 '## NOTES' section with task-style tab indentation and duplicates the heading. Repro in a scratch vault: pk.md = frontmatter type [[project]] + '- [ ] #task #prj Pk root ^prj' / '	- [ ] hand req' / '## Tasks' / '- [ ] #task Row a'. 'bob capture -- $'@pk+prj
- first note'' appends '## NOTES
	- first note' at end of file (a tab-indented bullet straight under an H2 reads as an indented code block); a second note capture yields '## NOTES
	- first note

	- second note
## NOTES
' (an extra empty '## NOTES' per capture). The first-req scoop has the same shape: '@pm+prj
- [ ] only req' on a ^prj with a loose note writes '## NOTES
	- loose'. Root cause predates bob-cli-on.6.1: note_home / ensure_notes_drawer / scoop_loose_notes (ca070941, bob-cli-on.3 block-layout) treat project_h2_drawers H2 sections as task drawers but write tab-indented children and mis-detect the section end. bob-cli-on.6.1 only made it reachable from requirement capture to ^prj targets (the plan said to record a follow-up rather than change task_block_layout there). Needs a decided ^prj notes home ('## Notes' H2 with column-zero bullets, matching the promotion/migration sections of plan:202611/task_requirements.md) in task_block_layout and its JS twin + RL vectors, then capture, toggle, and tidy follow it.

DISCOVERED ISSUE (from bob-cli-on.6.1.2 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1, re-verified by the bob-cli-on.6.1 land agent): capture grammar 29 (7cc94933) lets sub_bullet_depths exceed 2 beneath requirements, but the bob-mac-capture-owned mounted docs still say otherwise: docs/capture-previews.md:165 reads 'sub_bullet_depths (1 or 2)' and docs/protocol.md:382 describes depth handling for 'sub_bullet_depths' without the deeper levels. These files live in bob-mac-capture (gitignored mount in bob-cli), so the edit belongs with the Mac phases: bob-cli-on.14 (mac-nesting, which generalizes the Mac to any authored depth) should update that wording, and bob-cli-on.13 (mac-authoring) already owns docs/protocol.md for req_marker depth. bob-cli's own docs (capture.md, json-outputs.md, capture-syntax.md) already state depths may exceed 2.
